Mainstage 90 minutes Sunday, September 27, 2026 – 8:30 pm NY - 14TH ST. Mainstage UCBNY presents a *FREE* ASSSSCAT! Tickets for this show are free, but you must make a reservation online and arrive prior to 8:25pm for a seat. Seating is first come first served so any arrival after 8:25pm is not guaranteed. In-person and livestream tickets will become available on Friday, September 25th, at 12pm ET. Come back to this page then! If you do not reserve a seat in advance, please still show up anyways and we’ll try to get you in if there are some no-shows! ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country. What is ASSSSCAT? It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world! Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more! • “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine • “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine — In-person tickets are FREE to reserve! Livestream links can also be reserved FOR FREE! All tickets are released at the same time, specified above. All sales are final. The show starts at the time listed. If you are not at the theater more than 5 minutes before the start of the show, we may release your tickets to the waitlist. Lineup is subject to change. Under 17 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. Please use discretion, as all our shows can potentially use adult/sexual material, language, and images.
